hadith_en: It was narrated from Harythah ibn Wahb (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said: “ the Al-Jawwadh (coarse and uncivil) will not enter Paradise nor and the Al-Ja`dhari (arrogant).”.
syarah_en: In this Hadith, the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) warns against harshness, bad character, and arrogance toward others. He says: "The Jawwadh will not enter Paradise," — that is, the arrogant person with a large body. It is also said: the one who is bad-tempered."Nor the Ja`dhari," — that is, the one who is hard-hearted, conceals evil within, and boasts about what he does not truly possess.The reason for their exclusion from Paradise is their bad character and the arrogance in their souls toward the truth."The Jawwadh" refers to the arrogant person with a large body, and it is also said: the one with bad manners."And the Ja`dhari" refers to someone hard-hearted, who harbors evil within and boasts about what he does not possess.The reason they will not enter Paradise is due to their bad character and their arrogance toward the truth..
